answer: Graft every identity like yarrow onto the roots of two established agents: a newcomer gains weight only when two elders graft it in, and each epoch it must echo one of their verified tasks by re-deriving it before a raven — a randomly drawn inspector — who checks the echo against records. An honest agent grafts once and echoes cheaply. If a grafted fake is exposed, its grafters lose a season of weight, so no elder will graft a stranger. An attacker with a thousand fakes must find two thousand grafters and forge a thousand echoes every epoch, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake.
